user.title: Connect Dispatcharr
user.description: Enter the URL and API key of a Dispatcharr administrator. The key stays in the HA backend.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the URL and API key of a Dispatcharr administrator. The key stays in the HA backend.

reauth_confirm.title: Update API key
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the URL and API key of a Dispatcharr administrator. The key stays in the HA backend.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) server URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Enter a valid Dispatcharr API key.
error.insufficient_permissions: Dispatcharr requires an active administrator API key (user level 10) for viewer status and controls.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Dispatcharr. Check the URL, network and TLS certificate.
error.unsupported_api: This server does not provide the required Dispatcharr API. Verified with Dispatcharr 0.31.0.

control.title: Controls
control.description: Allow stop actions. Only HA administrators can stop sessions or channels. Disabled by default.

aliases.title: Edit device alias
aliases.description: Choose an observed device and enter an alias. Leave it empty to remove it. Dispatcharr uses IP + User-Agent; devices behind a proxy may appear identical. Media servers use the source and actual device ID.

media_add.title: Connect media server
media_add.description: Credentials stay in the HA backend. Use an administrator API key for Jellyfin/Emby or the owner token of a claimed Plex server. When editing, leave the key empty to keep it. Stop actions also require the global control switch.

data.name: Display name
data.enable_control: Allow stop actions on this server

media_edit.title: Connect media server
media_edit.description: Credentials stay in the HA backend. Use an administrator API key for Jellyfin/Emby or the owner token of a claimed Plex server. When editing, leave the key empty to keep it. Stop actions also require the global control switch.

data.name: Display name
data.enable_control: Allow stop actions on this server

media_remove.title: Remove server
media_remove.description: Remove {name} from this integration? This does not stop playback or remove the server itself.

abort.no_devices: No devices observed yet. Wait for an existing playback session and reopen this screen.
abort.media_limit: Up to 16 optional servers can be configured per instance.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) server URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.media_duplicate: This server is already configured in this instance.
error.media_invalid_auth: The server rejected this API key or token.
error.media_permissions: This credential cannot read the required server and session data. Use an administrator/owner credential.
error.media_cannot_connect: Cannot reach this server. Check its URL, network and certificate.
error.media_unsupported_api: The server returned an unsupported or incomplete API response. Check the selected server type.
error.plex_unclaimed: Link this Plex server to its owner account before adding it. Unclaimed servers cannot validate your token.

stop_session.name: End one session
stop_session.description: Stop only the supplied client ID. Never falls back to stopping the channel.

channel_uuid.name: Channel UUID
channel_uuid.description: The actual Dispatcharr channel UUID from the viewer sensor data.

client_id.name: Client ID
client_id.description: The actual client_id from Dispatcharr, not a username.

stop_channel.name: Stop channel for all viewers
stop_channel.description: Stops the whole channel including every viewer. Explicit confirmation required.

channel_uuid.name: Channel UUID
channel_uuid.description: The actual Dispatcharr channel UUID from the viewer sensor data.

confirm_all.name: Yes, stop this channel for ALL viewers

stop_media_session.name: End one media session
stop_media_session.description: Stop the exact session on the selected media server. The current item ID must still match.
